name: 08-code-review-code-blocks
description: Code review request: prose with messy whitespace around ABAP and JavaScript code blocks (normalize must not touch code).

messages.content:
You are a senior SAP developer reviewing ABAP and CAP code.   Point out bugs first, then style.



Keep the review short.

Please    review   this ABAP class:

```abap
CLASS zcl_invoice_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check
      IMPORTING iv_invoice TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_ok) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_invoice_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true
      FROM i_supplierinvoiceapi01
      WHERE supplierinvoice = @iv_invoice
      INTO @rv_ok.


  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
```



And   this CAP handler:

```js
module.exports = async function (srv) {
  srv.on('check',   async (req) => {
    const { invoice } = req.data


    return  await srv.run(SELECT.one.from('Invoices').where({ ID: invoice }))
  })
}
```



Thanks   a lot!
